name: httpserver
description: Expose a running DuckDB process over HTTP so clients can POST a SQL query and read JSON results. Single shared key or HTTP Basic auth, an embedded query UI, and zero-config startup. Best fit: small internal API surfaces and ad-hoc dashboards in front of a read-only DuckDB — not a hardened multi-tenant gateway.

cta.title: DuckDB as a small HTTP query API
cta.description: Install httpserver to put a SQL endpoint in front of a DuckDB instance — single-key or Basic auth, embedded UI, no extra infrastructure.
